component.name: Frank
component.summary: Native WebKitGTK browser with Skywire skynet integration

description.p: Frank is a native web browser built on an embedded WebKitGTK-6.0 (GTK4) engine, rendering modern JS/WebAssembly/WebGL/CSS at full fidelity. It is the desktop browser for the Skywire suite: browse dmsg-addressed skynet content directly from the address bar, via an embedded wasm-visor.
